notes: Thinkific is a Ruby-on-Rails + Liquid course platform. Default tenant hosting is {subdomain}.thinkific.com; many production sites use custom domains (e.g. courses.winefolly.com) where the URL regex fails and you MUST fall back to HTML signatures. Strongest cross-domain signals (VERIFIED on both a subdomain and a custom-domain site): (1) inline window.Thinkific = window.Thinkific || {} bootstrap script; (2) Rails csrf meta tags (meta[name=csrf-param][content=authenticity_token]); (3) theme CSS/JS bundles from assets.thinkific.com (custom_site_theme_required-<sha256>.css, application-themes-v2-<sha256>.js); (4) toga-css icon fonts from cdn.thinkific.com. Pages are fully server-rendered (raw HTML contains all course cards, footer, copyright) — no JS hydration needed, so ssr-static, safe to mirror from raw HTML. Uploaded media on import.cdn.thinkific.com / files.cdn.thinkific.com (front S3); theme assets on assets.thinkific.com / cdn-themes.thinkific.com. The 'Powered by Thinkific' badge (div.footer__white-label with inline SVG titled 'Teach online with Thinkific' linking to www.thinkific.com with utm_medium=powered-by) is present by default but REMOVABLE on paid plans, so absence does not rule out Thinkific — do not rely on it alone. Anti-bot: Cloudflare present (window.__CF$cv$params rocket-loader injection observed) but all fetches returned HTTP 200 with no challenge/captcha, so scraping works with a normal browser User-Agent. NOTE: reference URL learn.codewithchris.com returned a 302 redirect on direct fetch (dropped from referenceUrls); substituted courses.winefolly.com which fully confirms all signatures. Route conventions: /courses/{slug}, /collections, /bundles, /users/sign_in, /enrollments. Video is typically Wistia (fast.wistia.net); sign-in uses Google reCAPTCHA. No meta generator tag is emitted (confirmed absent).
